newsitem.title: CANADA: INSTANT VIEW - Canada May CPI up 1.5 pct on year.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - Canada May CPI up 1.5 pct on year.

text.p: Following are reactions to consumer price index data released by Statistics Canada on Tuesday.
Canada's unadjusted May consumer price index rose 0.1 percent in the month and 1.5. percent in the year, Statistics Canada said Tuesday. Core CPI rose 1.7 percent year-on-year.

Economists in a Reuters survey had forecast, on average, the unadjusted CPI to rise 0.2 percent on the month. The survey also forecast a 1.6 percent year-over-year rise in the all-items and a 1.8. percent increase in the core CPI.
